thread:
Elaine: Quick sync re: CalyxMotion renewal. Procurement wants a blanket PO with milestone invoicing (Q1/Q3). Legal flagged a data-residency clause we added — they say it needs to stay. Need sign path, final pricing, and whether we can accept milestone invoices vs monthly billing. Short timeline: they want signatures by end of week.
Miguel: Got it. We quoted 12-month term with 10% seat discount. Procurement pushing for 9mo to align with fiscal. If we shorten to 9mo discount drops to 5% — need alignment from AE.
Elaine: @Miguel can you confirm whether AE is ok with 5% for 9mo? They mentioned potential seat-add next quarter.
Miguel: Checked with rep — they prefer lower commit length but want consistent unit price. Rep asks if we can keep price but pro-rate the term (i.e., 9mo at 12mo list price, prorated). Is that allowed?
Kevin: Pricing ops note: we can do prorated invoicing but discount tiers are tied to committed months in contract. Doing 9mo at 12mo discount requires manual approval from Rev Ops. I can run a quick approval but need a business justification.
Taryn: Finance: milestone invoices are fine, we just need billing entity and vendor code now. CalyxMotion has two entities (US and EU) — which one will pay? If EU entity pays, we need VAT handling on the invoice.
Sophie: Legal: the added residency clause is acceptable but needs a short redline to limit scope to "customer data logs". Also we cannot accept flexible milestone billing that defers all payment to final milestone unless there's a payment guarantee. Propose adding a 30% upfront milestone.
Elaine: Ok — summary: need (1) vendor entity, (2) confirm term/pricing approach (9mo prorate vs 12mo discount), (3) milestone schedule incl. 30% upfront, (4) DocuSign envelope prepared with redline. I'll coordinate with rep and procurement.
Miguel: I'll ask AE to push procurement to accept the 30% upfront.
Kevin: I can draft the amendment for Rev Ops approval. Sample snippet below we can use in the amendment:
```
Amendment: Renewal Term: 9 months
Pricing: List price $X per seat, prorated for 9 months
Payment: 30% due at signing, 40% due at milestone 1 (prod enablement), 30% due at go-live
Billing Entity: [TBD]
```
Elaine: Perfect. @Taryn can you confirm vendor code and VAT path if EU entity?
Taryn: Vendor code 5472 is usable, but we'll need customer VAT ID. If EU entity used, change invoice template to include VAT reverse-charge note.
DocuSignBot: Envelope created: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D (status: created) :white_check_mark:
Sophie: I'll upload the short redline and legal signoff into the envelope once Kevin posts the amendment. Quick redline note: limit residency clause to "storage of customer logs in EU region only" and cap liability to standard SLA carveouts.
Elaine: Thanks team. Action items: Miguel -> get AE confirmation on 9mo prorate vs 12mo discount (ETA 2h). Kevin -> draft amendment for Rev Ops (ETA 4h). Taryn -> confirm vendor code & VAT ID with customer (ETA EOD). Sophie -> prep redline and stand by to upload. I'll follow up with procurement and update this thread. :thumbsup:
Miguel: On it. Will ping AE now.
Kevin: Starting the draft now. Will drop here when done.
Taryn: Reaching out to CalyxMotion billing contact; will update.
Elaine: If we get green on prorate + vendor entity today, we can hit end-of-week sign. Thanks all.
